verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime models onboarding through Person, Business, and Account Application API objects, and supports incremental KYC without opening an account. However, KYC/KYB is delivered by integrating a bank-approved third-party vendor rather than performed natively, so verification depends on an extra tool. Missing for 10: native or documented document collection, watchlist/OFAC screening, explicitly modeled application status states and transitions, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
